title: PMS Engineer – Marine PMS & Database Specialist
description:
**Company Description**
Norsetech Group specializes in building high-quality marine Planned Maintenance System (PMS) databases that allow ship operators to rely on their data rather than work around it. The company focuses on creating accurate job libraries, SFI coding structures, component hierarchies, and spares linkages, all sourced directly from makers’ manuals. Norsetech Group supports PMS build, migration, and configuration across platforms such as AMOS, DNV ShipManager, DANAOS, ABS Nautical Systems, Cloud Fleet Manager, and ShipNet. Services also include onboard inventory audits, spares cataloguing with QR and barcode tracking, digitization of manuals and records, vessel IT and cybersecurity, and managed back-office support to reduce administrative burdens for superintendents.

**Role Description**
The PMS Engineer – Marine PMS & Database Specialist is a full-time hybrid role based in Mumbai, with flexibility for some work-from-home arrangements. The role involves building, reviewing, and configuring PMS databases across multiple marine software platforms, ensuring accurate job libraries, component hierarchies, and spares linkages. The specialist will interpret makers’ technical manuals and vessel documentation, support PMS database migration projects, and coordinate with client teams to validate data integrity and system usability. Day-to-day tasks include collaborating with marine technical stakeholders, performing data quality checks, supporting onboard inventory and spares cataloguing initiatives, and preparing clear documentation and reports for internal and client use. The role may also support digitization efforts and contribute to continuous improvement of database standards and processes.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong skills in Expediting and work experience as an Expeditor to manage timely data, documentation, and materials flow.
* Candidates should possess Project Management skills to plan, coordinate, and deliver PMS database and migration projects within agreed timelines and quality standards.
* Candidates should possess Inspection skills to review technical data, verify component and spares information, and ensure PMS records align with makers’ manuals and vessel documentation.
* Candidates should possess Logistics Management skills to understand inventory flows, spares management, and the practical implications of data structures for onboard operations.
* Relevant qualifications such as a degree or diploma in Marine Engineering, Naval Architecture, Information Technology, or a related technical field are beneficial.
* Experience with marine PMS software (e.g., AMOS, DNV ShipManager, DANAOS, ABS Nautical Systems, Cloud Fleet Manager, ShipNet) and familiarity with SFI coding and vessel maintenance practices are highly desirable.
* Strong analytical and data management abilities, attention to detail, and proficiency with spreadsheets and database tools are important.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills, the ability to work collaboratively in hybrid teams

title: ERP Manager- NetSuite
description:
**Role Overview**

Exponents recently implemented NetSuite ERP together with a custom application, ExpoSync, and is now looking for an experienced ERP Manager to own the platform end-to-end. This is a senior, high-ownership individual contributor role: the person will be the single point of expertise for NetSuite across departments and geographies (India, Mexico and US) — running all day-to-day administration, architecture, and system/master-data integration activities independently and without supervision.

Beyond administration, this role is expected to shape how NetSuite is architected: designing workflows, process flows and SOPs, governing master data across systems, and owning integrations that keep NetSuite and connected platforms in sync. The ERP Manager will work largely as an individual coordinator, exercising independent judgment on design and implementation decisions, while staying in close, structured contact with Exponents’ System Integration (SI) partner for larger builds, escalations and specialized development.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Architecture, Workflow & Master Data**

•     Own the end-to-end architectural design of NetSuite workflows and business processes — translating business requirements into scalable system architecture independently, without requiring supervision.

•     Build architecture flow diagrams / workflows and SOPs, and manage and control them within NetSuite on an ongoing basis.

•     Define and govern master data management (MDM) standards within NetSuite — customers, vendors, items, chart of accounts and entities — ensuring a single, consistent source of truth across systems.

•     Design, own and manage system integrations between NetSuite and other business/master-data systems (ExpoSync, Power BI, RFID tools, and future platforms), ensuring data consistency and integrity across the landscape.

•     Drive continuous improvement of ERP architecture and workflows in line with business growth and evolving process needs.

**Platform Administration & Support**

•     Serve as the primary in-house owner and administrator of the NetSuite instance, supporting ~150+ users across departments in India and the US.

•     Manage user roles, permissions, and access across multiple departments and entities.

•     Troubleshoot day-to-day issues raised by Sales, Finance, Operations, and other departments; resolve or triage tickets promptly.

•     Build and maintain saved searches, reports, dashboards, custom forms, and workflows (SuiteFlow).

•     Write and maintain small-to-medium customizations using SuiteScript 2.0 (scripts, workflows, custom fields/records).

•     Monitor data integrity, system performance, and adherence to internal controls.

•     Support month-end/quarter-end processes from a systems standpoint, working closely with cross-functional teams.

•     Own NetSuite release updates — review new features, test in sandbox, and roll out changes with minimal disruption.

•     Create and maintain internal documentation and basic training material for end users.

**Stakeholder & Partner Coordination**

•     Operate as the sole in-house architectural and functional authority for NetSuite, exercising independent judgment on design decisions and managing all activities without day-to-day supervision.

•     Act as the primary point of contact with the NetSuite System Integration (SI) partner — scoping change requests, reviewing solution design, and validating delivered work for larger projects, escalations, or advanced customizations.

**Required Experience & Skills**

•     8–10 years of hands-on NetSuite administration and architecture experience (not purely functional/consulting) — genuine, independent ownership of an instance end-to-end.

•     Demonstrated ability to independently design NetSuite architecture, workflows and business process flows, translating requirements into scalable solutions with minimal oversight.

•     Strong working knowledge of SuiteScript 2.0 and SuiteFlow, with a track record of building and maintaining custom scripts/workflows.

•     Experience managing multi-entity / multi-subsidiary NetSuite environments (India, US and Mexico experience strongly preferred).

•     Proven experience owning master data management (MDM) practices — data governance, standardization and de-duplication across entities and systems.

•     Proven experience architecting and managing system integrations between NetSuite and third-party/master-data platforms (Power BI, RFID, custom applications such as ExpoSync).

•     Solid understanding of core modules relevant to Exponents: Sales/CRM, Order Management, Finance/Accounting, Inventory (as applicable).

•     Experience with roles, permissions, and security setup across departments.

•     NetSuite certification required: SuiteFoundation at minimum; NetSuite Administrator Certification strongly preferred.

•     Proven track record operating as a true individual contributor — capable of independently managing the full NetSuite function without supervision, while collaborating effectively with an external System Integration partner.

•     Comfortable working independently as the sole/lead in-house owner, with strong communication skills to support non-technical, cross-functional stakeholders.

•     Experience supporting US-based teams / working across US time zone overlap is a plus.

**Nice to Have**

•     Prior experience in a project-based business.

•     Exposure to NetSuite Analytics / SuiteAnalytics Workbook.

•     Exposure to enterprise data governance or MDM tools/frameworks.

•     Experience defining ERP architecture roadmaps.

•     Experience managing a NetSuite implementation partner relationship.

title: Architect - Data Modeller
description:
While technology is the heart of our business, a global and diverse culture is the heart of our success. We love our people and we take pride in catering them to a culture built on transparency, diversity, integrity, learning and growth.
  
  
If working in an environment that encourages you to innovate and excel, not just in professional but personal life, interests you- you would enjoy your career with Quantiphi!
  
  
**Architect Data Modeler**
**Exp Range**
: 8 - 13 Years
  
  
**Job Location**
: Mumbai , Bangalore, Trivandrum
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Data Modeler is responsible for the structural design of the platform's canonical and derived data assets. You will own the Common Data Model (CDM) at the schema level — the dimension, fact, bridge, and reference tables that hold normalized clinical, claims, and demographic data — and the source-to-target mappings (STTMs) that define how source-system data lands in CDM and how CDM data is reshaped into FHIR resources.
  
  
This role is hands-on. You will produce schema designs in collaboration with the architect, write STTM specifications that engineers implement against, and work with clinical informatics and source-system experts to ensure the model accurately reflects the data's clinical and operational meaning. Your output is the contract between source data and CDM, and between CDM and downstream consumers.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Own the schema-level design of the Common Data Model — DIM (patient, person, encounter, provider, organization), FACT (observation, diagnosis, procedure, medication administration, claim line, encounter), BRIDGE (relationship-qualifier-aware), and REF (terminology and crosswalk) tables. Design columns, types, NULL semantics, hash key composition, SCD2 patterns, and partitioning strategies in coordination with the architect
* Develop and maintain Source-to-Target Mappings (STTMs) for every source-system feed — EPIC HL7v2 ADT/ORU/ORM, Cerner HL7v2, ambulatory EHR feeds, state HIE CCDA, payer claims CSVs, FHIR ingestion. STTMs specify field-by-field source-path → CDM-column mapping with explicit transformation, NULL handling, and validation rules
* Develop and maintain STTMs for FHIR serialization — for each in-scope US Core 6.1 resource (Patient, Encounter, Condition, Observation, Procedure, Practitioner, Organization, AllergyIntolerance), specify how every FHIR element derives from CDM columns, including cardinality, profile constraints, and terminology bindings
* Design data product schemas — the longitudinal patient mart, population analytics aggregations, risk adjustment marts, HEDIS measure pre-aggregations. Each data product has a defined grain, columns, and refresh semantics
* Author and maintain unit specs at the model level under the spec-driven development framework. Each table has a versioned spec; model changes go through the spec review process before implementation
* Collaborate with data engineers to translate model specs into dbt implementations. Review dbt model code for adherence to the spec, including column naming, hash key construction, SCD2 macro usage, and test coverage
* Participate in source-system data profiling — analyze sample data from each source to identify quality issues, edge cases, and modeling implications before specs are finalized. Profile findings drive STTM design
* Define and enforce reference data (REF) management practices — terminology crosswalks (LOINC, SNOMED, ICD-10, RxNorm, CPT), source-code-to-standard-code mappings, and the SCD2 patterns that govern reference data evolution
* Document data dictionaries, lineage, and the canonical model glossary. Engage with Atlan or equivalent governance tooling to publish model documentation for downstream consumers
* Work with clinical informaticists and source-system experts to validate that the model and STTMs accurately represent clinical reality. STTMs are the contract between engineering and clinical informatics; you own that contract

**Required Skills And Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related quantitative field
* 5+ years of data modeling experience for large-scale data warehouses, data lakes, or data platforms
* Demonstrated ability to design conceptual, logical, and physical data models — dimensional modeling (Kimball), data vault, or hybrid patterns. This project uses a Kimball-influenced canonical model with SCD2 dimensions and per-source row preservation
* Strong SQL proficiency. Experience reading and reviewing dbt SQL models is required; ability to author dbt models is a plus
* Experience modeling for analytical and operational data layers simultaneously — understanding how a normalized canonical model serves both downstream analytics and FHIR API consumers
* Hands-on experience with healthcare data standards — HL7v2 segment-level structure, CCDA document structure, and FHIR R4 resource models. Familiarity with US Core profiles and FHIR Bundle composition
* Experience producing source-to-target mappings (STTMs) at field-level granularity for multi-source data integration projects
* Experience modeling SCD2 patterns and the operational implications of late-arriving data, restatement, and version closure
* Experience with terminology systems used in healthcare — LOINC, SNOMED CT, ICD-10, CPT, RxNorm — and their crosswalk patterns
* Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform data services (Cloud Storage, BigLake, Dataproc) and open table formats. Direct Iceberg experience is a plus
* Strong written communication skills. STTMs and model documentation are read across engineering, QA, clinical, and governance audiences

Nice-to-Have Skills
  
  

* Direct experience with the Optum Health Data Engine canonical model or comparable healthcare canonical models (OMOP, PCORnet CDM, Sentinel)
* Experience with master data management modeling — patient matching attributes, source-system identifier preservation, ECI lifecycle
* Experience with Atlan or comparable governance and lineage tooling
* Hands-on dbt authorship including macros, tests, and project structure
* Familiarity with FHIR Implementation Guides beyond US Core (CARIN BB, Da Vinci, IPA)
* Experience with data modeling tools (ER/Studio, Erwin, dbdiagram, SqlDBM) for diagram production

*If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us*
*!*

title: Associate Lead Testing
description:
While technology is the heart of our business, a global and diverse culture is the heart of our success. We love our people and we take pride in catering them to a culture built on transparency, diversity, integrity, learning and growth.
  
  
If working in an environment that encourages you to innovate and excel, not just in professional but personal life, interests you- you would enjoy your career with Quantiphi!
  
  
**QA Architect / Lead**
**Exp Range :**
8 - 13 Years
  
  
**Job location :**
Mumbai , Bangalore, Trivandrum
  
  
The QA Architect/Lead is responsible for the testing strategy and infrastructure across the entire platform. You will define the four-tier test framework (unit, integration, contract, acceptance), establish the conventions that ensure every spec-defined acceptance criterion has a verifying test, build out the validation infrastructure for parallel-run cutover from the existing Health Data Engine, and lead the load testing campaign that validates the platform's high-volume
  
  
capacity claims.
  
  
This role is technical-lead calibre. You will design test frameworks that data engineers consume, set the CI/CD gating policies that determine what merges and what doesn't, and lead the validation that determines when the platform is ready for production traffic. You will work in close partnership with the architect on spec-derived test conventions and with the data engineering team on the operational maturity of every component.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Define and own the four-tier test framework: unit (per spec acceptance criterion), integration (within-layer composition), contract (cross-layer schema and behaviour), and acceptance (end-to-end scenarios). Establish the conventions that distinguish them and the CI gates that enforce them
* Establish the spec-to-test traceability standard. Every acceptance criterion in a unit spec must have at least one named test that verifies it; test names reference the AC ID by convention; CI enforces coverage. The traceability is regulatory-defensible by design
* Build and maintain the test infrastructure — fixture management (HL7v2, CCDA, CSV, FHIR samples organized by source and DLQ scenario), DBT test runners, FHIR validator integration, Mini Cluster Flink test harnesses, HAPI test server harnesses for FHIR-Repository interceptor work, end-to-end test orchestration
* Establish synthetic test data conventions — no real PHI in fixtures; structured-but-synthetic patient names, identifiers, dates; reusable patterns for multi-source linkage scenarios; coverage of edge cases (NULLs, ECI merges, late-arriving data, validation failures)
* Lead the load testing campaign — design the eight to ten scenarios that validate sustained 50K msg/sec ingest, 150K msg/sec peaks, full DBT refresh at billion-row scale, 1,000 concurrent Starburst queries, 5,000 req/sec FHIR API, MDM degradation behaviour, and reprocessing during steady state. Lead execution; report against acceptance criteria
* Lead the parallel-run validation framework — for the 30-60 day cutover period when the new platform ingests alongside the existing Health Data Engine, establish what data is compared between the two systems, what tolerances are accepted, what reconciliation reports are produced, and what triggers a rollback decision
* Define performance SLOs and monitoring strategy. Every component has measurable latency, throughput, and freshness budgets. Build dashboards that operators use during incidents and that establish trend baselines over time
* Define and enforce CI/CD test gates — what blocks PR merge (spec lint, AC coverage, unit tests, integration tests, lint/format), what runs nightly (full integration suite, contract tests, slow scenarios), what runs in stage before promotion (acceptance tests). Codify in pipeline configuration and runbooks
* Build out test automation for FHIR profile validation — every Bundle published is validated against US Core 6.1 in CI and in the runtime path. Establish the FHIR validator deployment, the profile pack management, and the test patterns that prove conformance
* Lead testing for the bidirectional FHIR flow — verifying loop prevention via origin tagging works under load, that the FHIR-Repository egress interceptor captures every client-originated change, that the loopback Flink job applies write-authority rules correctly, and that no echoes propagate
* Establish testing patterns for MDM integration — synthesizing match/no-match/multi-match scenarios, validating ECI assignment correctness, validating ECI\_MERGE and ECI\_SPLIT handling end-to-end, validating DLQ routing for MDM failures
* Lead validation of data quality at every layer — DBT test suites for CDM, freshness checks at every layer boundary, anomaly detection for ingestion patterns, governance integration for quality metric publication to Atlan
* Mentor data engineers on test authorship under the spec-driven development framework. Tests are part of every PR; their quality is part of the PR review; the QA lead sets the bar
* Participate in incident response and root cause analysis. Drive test additions that prevent recurrence — every production incident becomes a new acceptance criterion in the affected spec and a new test in the suite

**Required Skills And Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field
* 8+ years of QA experience with at least 3-5 years focused on data quality, data warehousing, or data platform testing, and 2+ years in a lead or architect role
* Demonstrated experience defining and operating QA strategies for large-scale data platforms in cloud environments — preferably GCP
* Strong Python and SQL skills for test framework authorship. Familiarity with pytest and dbt-test conventions required
* Experience with data validation across batch, streaming (Kafka), and event-driven pipelines
* Experience with dbt — specifically dbt's native testing framework, dbt-expectations or dbt-utils packages, custom test authorship via macros, and source freshness checks
* Experience testing Iceberg or other open-table-format-backed warehouses — schema evolution edge cases, partition handling, snapshot semantics, and CoW vs MoR behavioral differences
* Experience with healthcare data quality testing — HL7v2 parsing edge cases, FHIR profile conformance validation, terminology binding validation, master data quality
* Experience designing and executing load tests for data platforms at scale — JMeter, Gatling, Locust, or custom load generators. Familiarity with realistic load profile design (not just throughput, but representative mix of operations)
* Experience with parallel-run validation and reconciliation between legacy and replacement data systems
* Strong CI/CD experience — GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Cloud Build. Ability to design pipeline gates and integrate test execution into PR and release workflows
* Excellent analytical, communication, and collaboration skills. The role works across engineering, architecture, governance, and customer stakeholder groups

Nice-to-Have Skills
  
  

* Experience with the HL7 FHIR validator, Inferno, or HAPI FHIR validation tooling
* Atlan experience for data quality metric publication and governance integration
* Experience with chaos engineering or resilience testing for streaming data systems
* Experience integrating spec-driven or contract-first frameworks with QA workflows
* Test management tools experience (TestRail, Zephyr, qTest)
* Experience working in HIPAA-regulated environments — synthetic PHI generation, audit trail validation, regulatory test evidence
* QA or cloud platform certifications

*If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us*
*!*

title: Principal Member Technical Staff
description:
**Company Description**
At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.
  
  
**Job Description**
Gracenote is the content business unit of Nielsen that powers the world of media entertainment. Our metadata solutions help media and entertainment companies around the world deliver personalized content search and discovery, connecting audiences with the content they love. Weʼre at the intersection of people and media entertainment. With our cutting-edge technology and solutions, we help audiences easily find TV shows, movies, music and sports across multiple platforms. As the world leader in entertainment data and services, we power the worldʼs top streaming platforms, cable and satellite TV providers, media companies, consumer electronics manufacturers, music services and automakers to navigate and succeed in the competitive streaming world. Our metadata entertainment solutions have a global footprint of 80+ countries, 100K+ channels and catalogs, 70+ sports and 100M+ music tracks, all across 35 languages.
  
  

* Responsible for driving Technology & good practices in Engineering in their respective teams.
* Partner with the Product team to translate vague business requirements into concrete, feasible technical roadmaps.
* Actively participate in development along with team members for as much as 60% of their time, creating modules & systems that can then be treated as a working reflection of the best practices.
* Cross-System Integration ensuring data flow seamlessly & consistently across ingestion, processing and data deliveries to end customers.
* Work closely with Data Science, DevOps, and Frontend architects to ensure our backend infrastructure supports emerging needs.
* Being responsible for Scaling, Performance & Quality.
* Experiment with new & relevant technologies and tools, and drive adoption while measuring yourself on the impact you can create.
* Implementation of long-term technology vision for your teams.
* Creating architectures & designs for new solutions around existing and new problem spaces.
* Responsible for the architecture of your platform; ensuring it is aligned to the long term requirements and the platform vision.
* Drive technology & tool choices for your team & be responsible for them.
* Drive technology forums & rhythms in the team to drive best practices. Establish organization-wide engineering standards (coding guidelines, API contracts, security protocols, design standards) to ensure consistency across different teams.
* Mentor and guide Senior engineers, fostering a culture of learning and collaboration within the team.
* Going beyond your role and contributing to make the organization & business better.

**Qualifications**
**Experience & Education**

* Bachelorʼs degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 15+ years of professional experience in software engineering, with a proven track record of designing, developing, and scaling complex, enterprise-grade applications from scratch.

**Core Backend & Architecture**

* Backend Expertise: Advanced proficiency in Java, Scala, or Python ecosystems optimized for high-throughput, low-latency workloads (Familiarity with languages like Rust, Golang for performance critical components & services is a strong plus).
* Distributed Systems: Deep expertise in microservices architecture, RESTful API design, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), and building highly available, fault-tolerant, resilient systems.
* Event-Driven Design: In-depth knowledge of asynchronous communication, messaging queues, and event-driven architectures.
* Full-Stack Awareness: Familiarity with front-end technologies (e.g., HTML, CSS, JavaScript) is preferred.

**Data Engineering**

* Data Architecture: Strong command of distributed data architectures, data engineering constructs, and building scalable data pipelines, including expertise in both real-time streaming and batch processing paradigms (e.g., Lambda or Kappa architectures).
* Datastores: Deep understanding of designing, scaling, and optimizing a variety of datastores across both SQL and NoSQL.
* AI/ML Foundations: Working knowledge of machine learning and data science concepts to effectively integrate ML models and data workflows.

**Cloud, Infra & DevOps**

* Cloud Platforms: Extensive hands-on experience designing for cloud environments (primarily AWS), leveraging cloud-native platform constructs, and driving cost-efficient architecture (FinOps).
* Containerization: Proficiency with containerization and orchestration technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
* Observability & Reliability: Deep understanding of system observability, distributed tracing, telemetry, and establishing robust monitoring for large-scale production systems.
* Engineering Excellence: Strong knowledge of CI/CD tools and practices. Proven experience with Test-Driven Development (TDD) and automated testing frameworks to ensure system reliability.

**Leadership & Execution**

* Process Champion: Standard-bearer for modern SDLC practices, understanding of software development methodologies (Agile, Scrum, etc.), and infrastructure management.
* Autonomy & Problem Solving: Exceptional problem-solving skills with the ability to navigate architectural ambiguity, work highly independently, and elevate a team environment.
* Communication: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to mentor senior engineers, collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders, and drive technical alignment.

**Additional Information**
Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

* Commvault does not conduct interviews by email or text.
* We will never ask you to submit sensitive documents (including banking information, SSN, etc) before your first day.
* Commvault recruiters may contact prospective candidates through LinkedIn and other professional networking platforms regarding career opportunities. If you are unsure whether a recruiting communication is legitimate, review the profile to ensure they have a badge verifying them as a Commvault employee.

For over 25 years, more than 100,000 organizations and a vast partner ecosystem have relied on Commvault to reduce risks, improve governance, and do more with data.

We have an outstanding career opportunity for Senior Engineer- C# (with React) at Bangalore, Hyderabad and Pune locations. * Collaborative and self-driven, with experience working across teams and time zones.

* Security and SaaS experience strongly preferred.

**You’ll Love Working Here Because**

Stavpay serves Hedge Funds, Private Equity firms, and Family Offices, providing robust financial controls, real-time visibility, and deep integration with leading accounting systems.
  
  
Stavpay is a highly customizable and configurable platform. Every client onboarding involves tailoring the system - custom allocation rules, financial reports, data loaders, and configurations - to precisely fit the unique workflows of institutional finance clients.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Senior Implementation Engineer to lead client onboarding on the Stavpay platform. This is a senior individual contributor and team leadership role - you will own end-to-end technical onboarding delivery, write complex SQL scripts and ETL loaders, configure custom allocations and reports, and ensure every client goes live accurately and on time.
  
  
Beyond hands-on delivery, you will mentor junior implementation team members, prepare delivery plans, assign tasks, and drive structured execution across onboarding projects. You will also interact directly with clients - Hedge Funds, Private Equity firms, and Family Offices - to gather requirements, manage expectations, and ensure a smooth onboarding experience.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end technical onboarding of new clients onto the Stavpay platform
* Analyse client-specific financial workflows and translate them into precise platform configurations
* Write complex SQL scripts and stored procedures to support custom data and reporting requirements
* Build and maintain custom ETL loaders for data ingestion from client source systems
* Develop and configure custom allocation rules and financial reports per client specifications

title: Data Architect
description:
**At a Glance: The Story Behind AMINA**

Founded in April 2018 and headquartered in Zug, AMINA Bank is a pioneer in the financial industry. In August 2019, AMINA received a Swiss banking and securities dealer license from FINMA. The broad, vertically integrated spectrum of services, combined with the highest security standards, make AMINA’s value proposition unique.

AMINA operates globally from its regulated hubs in Switzerland, Abu Dhabi, and Hong Kong to offer fiat and crypto services to progressive investors, traditional and crypto-native alike, whether individuals, corporates, or institutions.

CVVC Global Report and CB Insights named AMINA as one of the Top 50 Companies within the blockchain ecosystem. Aite Group awarded AMINA their 2021 Digital Wealth Management Impact Innovation Award in the ‘Digital Startup of the Year’ category, and LinkedIn listed AMINA as one of the Top Startups 2021 in Switzerland. In 2022, AMINA won the Digital Assets Offering or Service at the WealthBriefing Swiss EAM Awards, and the bank was also recognised for its product offering SEBAX and won the Best ETP of the Year award at the Swiss ETF Awards 2022. In 2023, AMINA won the European WealthBriefing Award in the Digital Assets Solution, Fund Manager category.

AMINA India is a wholly owned subsidiary of AMINA Bank AG. AMINA India acts as a virtual extension of the bank supporting activities spanning trading & liquidity management, digital assets research, marketing, investment solutions, risk management, account management, mid/back-office, product management, technology & engineering, IT support, finance and human resources.

**Your Mission (Should You Choose to Accept It)**

We are looking for a hands-on Data Architect with strong expertise in Microsoft Azure, particularly Azure Synapse Analytics and Microsoft Fabric, to design, develop and evolve scalable enterprise data platforms.

This is a design-and-build role, combining data architecture with hands-on data engineering. The candidate will be responsible for translating business and technical requirements into architecture and then actively contributing to the design, development, implementation, optimization and troubleshooting of data solutions.

The role requires strong ownership across data architecture, data modelling, batch and real-time processing, data integration, data quality, performance, security and platform engineering.

You will define data models, integration patterns and engineering standards, guide implementation, and ensure solutions meet business requirements for security, governance, reliability, performance and cost.

**Your AMINA To-Do List**

* Design, develop & maintain end-to-end data solutions across Data Lake, Data Warehouse, Lakehouse and Analytics platforms.
* Design and develop scalable batch, incremental, CDC and real-time/streaming data pipelines.
* Provide deep technical expertise with Hands-on development using Azure Synapse, Azure Data Factory, ADLS Gen2, Event Hubs and Databricks.
* Design & Implement Medallion/Lakehouse architectures, data models, ingestion frameworks and reusable engineering patterns.
* Develop complex SQL, PySpark and data transformation pipelines and perform code reviews.
* Build technical POCs and prototypes and convert validated designs into production-ready solutions
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex data pipeline, performance, data quality and platform issues.
* Optimize data platforms for performance, scalability, reliability and cloud cost.
* Implement monitoring, observability, error handling, recovery and reconciliation mechanisms.
* Implement & Maintain CI/CD, DevOps, security, governance and data engineering standards.
* Maintain architecture decisions, technical documentation and platform roadmaps.
* Evaluate and contribute to adoption of Microsoft Fabric, Databricks and other modern data technologies.
* Work closely with Data Engineering, BI, Cloud, Security and business teams to deliver production-ready data solutions.
* Balance architecture quality, development effort, delivery timelines, performance, reliability and cost.
* Challenge existing designs and propose pragmatic, technology-agnostic solutions based on business and technical requirements.

**Your golden ticket to the AMINA team:**

* Strong hands-on experience in Azure Data Engineering and Data Architecture.
* Deep expertise in Azure Synapse Analytics.
* Strong experience with Azure Data Factory and ADLS Gen2.
* Strong understanding of Data Lake, Data Warehouse and Lakehouse architectures.
* Hands-on experience designing and developing batch, incremental and streaming data pipelines.
* Strong SQL, Python & and data modelling skills.
* Hands-on experience with Spark/PySpark and distributed data processing.
* Experience with large-scale enterprise data platforms and complex data integration.
* Strong understanding of cloud architecture, scalability, performance, reliability and cost optimization.
* Experience with CI/CD, DevOps and production data platform management.
* Ability to design, develop, deploy and troubleshoot data solutions independently.
* Ability to document architecture decisions and guide engineering teams.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with Microsoft Fabric.
* Azure Databricks / Delta Lake.
* Kafka / Confluent / Event Hubs.
* Microsoft Purview.
* Event-driven architecture.
* Power BI and enterprise semantic models.
* Experience with data governance, data quality and observability.
* Experience in financial services, banking or other regulated industries.

**Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate is a builder-architect — someone who can understand the requirement, design the architecture, develop the solution, troubleshoot it in production and guide the engineering team. They should be comfortable working hands-on with data pipelines and code while also making architecture-level decisions. They should be able to challenge existing designs constructively and select the right technology based on business requirements, scalability, performance, reliability, security and cost, rather than technology preference.

At Databricks, we are on a mission to empower our customers to solve the world's toughest data problems by utilising the the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform.

title: SAP BDC Senior Consultant
description:
**Job Title:**
SAP BDC Senior Consultant

**Location :**
India (Delhi, Noida, Mumbai, Pune)

**Role summary**

We are hiring an SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC) Consultant to design and deliver BDC and Datasphere solutions from our offshore delivery centre, working alongside onshore architects and client teams.

**Working model:**
Offshore, with overlap to UK and client time zones

**Experience:**
5+ years in SAP BW/4HANA and/or SAP HANA Cloud

**About the role**

Invenio Business Solutions is an SAP Silver Partner with UK, Middle East and India entities. Our Data, AI and Innovation practice helps clients move from established SAP BW estates to SAP Business Data Cloud, Datasphere and SAP Analytics Cloud.

Many of our clients run BW/4HANA today and are assessing how to modernise onto BDC. You will turn that into working solutions: migrating and remodelling BW content, building Datasphere models, and integrating with SAP and non-SAP sources on BTP.

**Key responsibilities**

* Design and build data models in SAP Datasphere within an SAP Business Data Cloud landscape, including spaces, local and remote tables, views, analytic models and data access controls.
* Assess existing SAP BW/4HANA (and BW on HANA) estates and plan migration or coexistence paths into BDC, including use of the BW Data Product Generator and BW PCE where appropriate.
* Configure and consume SAP-managed data products in BDC, and help design customer-managed data products.
* Build data integration flows from S/4HANA, ECC and non-SAP sources using replication flows, data flows, transformation flows and task chains.
* Develop and optimise SQL and SQLScript logic in SAP HANA Cloud and Datasphere, with attention to performance and cost.
* Work with SAP BTP services (subaccounts, connectivity, Cloud Connector, security and role setup) to support integration and deployment.
* Support SAP Analytics Cloud consumption, including live connections and model design for reporting and planning.
* Produce technical designs, build documentation, test scripts and handover material to Invenio standards.
* Take part in estimation, sprint planning and daily coordination with onshore teams and client stakeholders.
* Contribute to reusable accelerators, templates and internal knowledge sharing across the practice.

Essential experience and skills

* At least 5 years of hands-on experience with SAP BW/4HANA and/or SAP HANA Cloud, across modelling, extraction and performance tuning.
* Strong BW/4HANA modelling: ADSOs, CompositeProviders, Open ODS views, transformations, DTPs and process chains.
* Solid SQL and SQLScript skills, including calculation views and HANA native modelling.
* Working knowledge of SAP Datasphere: spaces, data builder, business builder, replication and transformation flows.
* A good grasp of SAP BTP: account model, connectivity and Cloud Connector, security and roles, and how BTP services underpin BDC and Datasphere.
* Experience extracting data from S/4HANA or ECC, including CDS views and ODP-based extraction.
* At least one full-lifecycle SAP data warehousing implementation.
* Clear written and spoken English, and confidence working directly with onshore and client teams.

Desirable experience.

BDC is a recent SAP offering, so we recognise that few candidates will have several BDC projects behind them. Delivery on at least one BDC project with Datasphere is a must.

* Delivery on at least one SAP Business Data Cloud project that included SAP Datasphere, ideally covering data products and BW migration or coexistence.
* Experience with BW Data Product Generator, BW Private Cloud Edition or BW bridge.
* SAP Analytics Cloud modelling for reporting and planning.
* Exposure to SAP Databricks within BDC, or to Databricks, Snowflake or Google BigQuery alongside SAP data.
* Familiarity with data governance, lineage and cataloguing in Datasphere.
* Awareness of how BDC data products support AI and analytics use cases, such as SAP Joule and SAP AI Core.
* Experience in agile delivery and with tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps.
* Offshore working model and personal attributes
* This role is based offshore and works with onshore leads and clients, mainly in the UK, Europe and the Middle East.
* Flexibility to overlap with UK working hours for key meetings and handovers.
* Ownership of offshore build tasks from design sign-off through to unit testing and handover.
* Proactive, clear status updates, raising risks and blockers early rather than waiting to be asked.
* Comfortable working from written specifications and asking good questions where they are incomplete.
* Willingness to travel occasionally for project workshops or go-live support.
* Curiosity about SAP's evolving data and AI roadmap, and a willingness to learn new BDC capabilities as they are released.

title: Yardi Systems Administrator (Commercial Retail CRE)
description:
**ROLE: Yardi Systems Administrator
  
  
Salary: $3,500 USD/Monthly
  
  
POSITION SUMMARY:**
We are seeking a highly skilled
**Yardi Systems Administrator**
to serve as the sole internal owner, technical expert, and platform strategist for our Yardi ecosystem. Our firm primarily invests in commercial retail real estate, meaning our operations require a deep understanding of complex retail leasing structures, intricate CAM reconciliations, and variable sales tracking.
  
  
In this role, you will bridge the gap between our technology stack and our business operations. You will be responsible for system configuration, user permissions, database health, custom reporting, and onboarding new retail assets. The ideal candidate doesn't just know how to configure Yardi—they understand the underlying financial and operational mechanics of commercial retail real estate.
  
  
**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* System Administration & Optimization

+ Serve as the primary point of contact and subject matter expert (SME) for all things related to Yardi Voyager (Commercial/Retail module) and integrated applications (e.g., CommercialCafe, Yardi Advanced Budgeting & Forecasting)
+ Manage user provisioning, custom security roles, workflow approvals, and system menus to ensure data security and compliance
+ Lead the technical onboarding, data migration, and setup of newly acquired commercial retail assets into the Yardi database
+ Monitor, test, and implement Yardi system updates, plug-ins, and new module rollouts, ensuring zero disruption to daily business operations

* Retail Operations & Financial Support

+ Support the property management and accounting teams with complex, retail-specific configurations, including Common Area Maintenance (CAM) setups, tax/insurance reconciliations, and recovery configurations
+ Oversee the technical setup and execution of Percentage Rent parameters, gross sales tracking, and variable retail leasing structures
+ Troubleshoot system errors related to retail lease administration, tenant billings, and recurring charge schedules

* Reporting & Business Intelligence

+ Design, develop, and maintain custom reports and dashboards using Yardi Spreadsheet Reporting (YSR), Yardi Correspondence, or SQL/SSRS to support executive decision-making
+ Collaborate with asset management and finance teams to optimize data flow, automate manual workarounds, and ensure data integrity across all portfolios

**Requirements**

* Education: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Finance, Real Estate, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
* Yardi Expertise: Minimum of 3-5 years of hands-on administration experience specifically within Yardi Voyager Commercial/Retail. (Applications with purely residential or multifamily experience will not be considered)
* Industry Knowledge: Solid understanding of commercial real estate accounting principles, commercial lease logic, and retail recovery mechanics (CAM, recurring charges, overage rent)
* Technical Skills: Proficiency with Yardi database structures, database mapping, and writing custom reports (YSR, Yardi Script, or basic SQL query writing)
* Preferred/Nice-to-Have:

+ Experience with Yardi Advanced Budgeting & Forecasting (ABF)
+ Experience implementing or managing CommercialCafe or tenant portals
+ Prior experience working at a commercial real estate investment, asset management, or development firm

* Soft Skills:

+ Strong analytical troubleshooting skills—someone who loves solving complex data puzzles
+ Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical jargon into clear business insights for non-technical team members
+ Self-motivated and comfortable acting as the sole, go-to Yardi expert in the organization

**Working Requirements**

* Fully remote
* Fluent in English
* Will work 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern Time (EST)

title: Sr Principal Engineer
description:
As a Sr. Principal Engineer, you will lead the design, stabilization, and delivery of scalable, secure, and high-performance enterprise solutions across the full stack using C#, .NET, SQL Server, Angular, and Azure Cloud. You will provide technical leadership in architecture, development, and deployment while mentoring engineering teams and collaborating closely with Product, Infrastructure, and business stakeholders. Experience or knowledge of
**IT Asset Disposition (ITAD) and reverse logistics**
processes is highly desirable.
  
  
**Your role:**
**Technical Leadership & Architecture**

* Own end-to-end solution design and lifecycle, including architecture, development, deployment, and production support.
* Lead efforts to stabilize and optimize L1 (first level) and L3 (third level) production support systems, reducing downtime and improving incident resolution times.
* Define enterprise-wide architectural standards and best practices for full-stack development on Microsoft technologies and Azure Cloud.
* Provide technical oversight, lead code reviews, and ensure software quality, security, and performance across the stack.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues spanning frontend, APIs, backend, and cloud infrastructure; lead incident and problem management.
* Guide disaster recovery planning and monitor production environments for reliability and scalability.

**Full-Stack Solution Development**

* Architect and build microservices and APIs using C# and .NET, optimized for Azure Cloud deployment.
* Develop rich, responsive frontend applications using Angular, ensuring excellent user experience and performance.
* Design and implement self-serve applications enabling users to onboard, configure, and manage services independently.
* Build and maintain API gateways to secure, route, and monitor service APIs effectively.
* Lead tenant onboarding processes and systems to support multi-tenant architecture and seamless customer adoption.
* Leverage Azure Cloud services including App Services, Functions, SQL Database, and DevOps pipelines for scalable, fault-tolerant applications.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and monitoring to support rapid, reliable delivery.
* Champion Agile methodologies and foster collaborative, cross-functional team environments.
* Apply domain knowledge of ITAD and reverse logistics workflows to design solutions that optimize asset lifecycle management.

**What you bring to the role:**

* Bachelor’s in Computer Science or related field (Master’s preferred) with 15+ years in enterprise software engineering.
* Strong full-stack development expertise using C#, .NET, SQL Server, Angular, and Azure Cloud services.
* Proven experience designing and scaling enterprise systems with high traffic and transaction volumes.
* Demonstrated success in stabilizing and enhancing L1 and L3 production support systems, improving system reliability and support responsiveness.

* Experience with cloud-native architectures, containerization, and orchestration tools (Kubernetes, Docker) a plus.
* Skilled in CI/CD tools, automated testing, and Agile delivery practices.
* Experience leading technical teams in onsite-offshore models and mentoring senior engineers.
* Excellent communication skills and ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders.

**Why join us:**
Join Ingram Micro as a Sr. Principal Engineer and shape the future of global technology platforms by leading full-stack development initiatives using Microsoft technologies and Azure Cloud. Your expertise in production system stabilization, self-serve platforms, and ITAD will help us deliver reliable, innovative solutions that empower our partners worldwide.

title: Consulting Architect - Platform
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
  
  
**What is The Role:**
You are the person a customer calls when their Elasticsearch platform is the problem, or when they need one designed properly the first time.
  
  
That means you decide the shape of a cluster and then defend that decision — node topology, shard strategy, data tiers, lifecycle and retention — with the sizing arithmetic to back it up. It also means you can follow a performance problem beyond Elastic itself. We need someone whose instinct is to look down the stack and sideways to whatever else shares the infrastructure, rather than stopping at the cluster API.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing:**

* Design and build Elasticsearch platforms for customers across self-managed, orchestrated and managed deployments, including air-gapped and regulated environments
* Own sizing and capacity planning as a derivation from workload characteristics — ingest rate, document shape, retention, query concurrency, growth — validated by benchmark rather than estimated from a form
* Run health checks and remediation on production estates, and redesign sharding, mapping and index strategies where the original design no longer holds
* Lead major-version upgrades, snapshot and disaster recovery strategy, and multi-cluster architectures
* Diagnose performance problems across the full stack — Elastic, the JVM, the operating system, storage and network — and across adjacent systems in the data path
* Work directly with customer architects, platform owners and engineering leadership; run discovery, present designs, and own the technical outcome of an engagement end to end
* Build reusable tooling, automation and IP that makes the next engagement faster, including AI-assisted tooling for diagnosis, configuration and reporting
* Mentor other consultants and contribute to the GCC's technical practice

**What You Bring:**
**Elastic depth — non-negotiable**
We
**are not looking**
for someone who will learn Elastic on the job.
  
  

* 8+ years hands-on with the Elastic Stack, substantially on cluster and platform work rather than dashboarding or pipeline authoring
* Shard strategy you can derive, not recite — how you arrived at a shard count and size for a given workload, what you traded off, and what you got wrong the first time
* Index and mapping design, and why those choices drive cluster performance
* Lifecycle and retention across data tiers, including the cost and latency implications of each
* Snapshot, restore and disaster recovery designed and executed, not just configured
* Major-version upgrades in production — the sequencing, the breaking changes, the rollback position
* More than one deployment model: self-managed plus at least one managed or orchestrated option
* Cluster stability and performance troubleshooting — heap and garbage collection, circuit breakers, thread pool rejections, shard allocation, expensive queries
* Elastic Certified Engineer, or the demonstrable knowledge to obtain it within your first quarter
* Strong Linux and operating system fundamentals, with solid grounding in storage and networking
* A working understanding of how infrastructure conditions translate into Elastic symptoms, and how infrastructure choices constrain what a deployment can do
* Experience troubleshooting on shared infrastructure, where the cause of your problem is another workload's behaviour and resolving it means engaging the team that owns it

**Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People:**
As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.
  
  
We strive to have parity of benefits across regions, and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.
  
  

* Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
* Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
* Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
* Generous number of vacation days each year
* Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service

You will be expected to defend choices with technical depth and adapt them when warranted.Key ResponsibilitiesOwn the end-to-end architecture across ingestion (Flink + PySpark), storage (Iceberg on GCS with BigLake Metastore), transformation (dbt over Starburst), FHIR serialization (flat FHIR Iceberg → bundles → FHIR-Repository), and consumption (Starburst, FHIR API, data products). Maintain the architecture specification document and its companion design docs.Lead the design and evolution of the Common Data Model (CDM): the dimensional, fact, bridge, and reference table classes; SCD2 semantics; hash key conventions; the write-authority matrix that governs cross-source field precedence. CDM is the project's central design artifact and the architect owns it.Define the bidirectional FHIR flow with origin-tag-based loop prevention. Specify the FHIR repository egress interceptor contract, the loopback Flink consumer pipeline, and the boundary semantics between FHIR-repo-owned and CDM-owned fields.Define the patient identity resolution architecture using Informatica MDM, including the synchronous-call pattern at ingestion, the asynchronous ECI change event pipeline, and the DLQ taxonomy for MDM failures.Set the standards every other role implements against — naming conventions, hash algorithms (SHA-256 BINARY 32, 0x1F separator, NULL handling), Iceberg table properties (CoW vs MoR, partitioning, compaction cadence), DLQ taxonomy, observability (metric naming, structured logging, correlation ID propagation), and security (PHI handling, encryption, audit logging).Own the spec-driven development framework's program-level and component-level specs. Approve significant changes to platform-wide rules. Architect specs are the constitution every implementing engineer references.Drive the high-volume capacity design — sustained 50K msg/sec ingest target with 150K peak, billions of rows in CDM facts, thousand-concurrent Starburst workloads, thousands per second FHIR API. Lead capacity planning, validation, and the parallel-run cutover from the existing Health Data Engine.Evaluate and recommend technology choices that are still open — Confluent Cloud tier, Starburst Galaxy vs Enterprise, FHIR-Repository sizing, multi-region failover topology. Build option analyses; defend recommendations with concrete trade-off matrices.Provide architectural review for engineering work. Review specs at the component and unit level when they touch architectural concerns. Mentor data engineers and data modelers on design principles.Lead architectural review meetings with customer technical stakeholders — including the Health Data Engine retirement team, governance, security, and clinical informatics. Translate complex trade-offs into language non-architect audiences can engage with.Establish and evolve the disaster recovery, backup, and reprocessing strategy across all platform layers. RPO under 5 minutes for streaming, RTO under 4 hours for full platform recovery.Required Skills And QualificationsBachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field8+ years of data engineering experience with at least 3-5 years in a Data Architect or Lead Data Engineer roleDeep expertise architecting and operating large-scale data platforms on Google Cloud Platform — Cloud Storage, Dataproc (specifically with Flink and Spark workloads), Cloud Composer, Secret Manager, Workload Identity, IAM, networking. BigQuery experience is useful background but is not used as the primary warehouse on this projectHands-on experience with Apache Iceberg in production — table properties, partitioning strategies, snapshot semantics, schema evolution, CoW vs MoR write modes, compaction operations, and integration with metastore catalogs (BigLake, Glue, Polaris, or Nessie)Production experience with Starburst (Galaxy or Enterprise) or Trino for analytical workloads against open table formats. Understanding of query planning, predicate pushdown, partition pruning, and workload separation patternsStrong experience with streaming architectures using Apache Flink and Apache Kafka — stateful stream processing, exactly-once semantics, checkpointing, backpressure handling, and integration with Iceberg sinksExpert SQL and strong programming skills in Python. Familiarity with PySpark and PyFlink for batch and streaming respectivelyDeep experience with dbt — model materialization strategies, macros, tests, sources, exposures, project structure for large model graphs (hundreds of models). Specific experience with dbt-trino adapter is a strong plusComprehensive understanding of healthcare data standards: HL7v2 (ADT, ORU, ORM message types and segment-level parsing), CCDA, and FHIR R4 with US Core 6.1 profiles. Experience with FHIR Bundle assembly, profile validation, and resource versioning semanticsHands-on experience with FHIR runtime platforms — FHIR-Repository or HAPI FHIR — including the interceptor framework, MDM module, and channel/subscription mechanismsExperience with master data management for patient identity resolution. Informatica MDM specifically is preferred; equivalent experience with Verato, NextGate, or QuadraMed translatesExperience designing for HIPAA-regulated environments — PHI handling discipline, encryption at rest and in transit, audit logging conventions, BAA-relevant vendor decisionsDemonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives, make critical architectural decisions under uncertainty, and influence diverse stakeholders. Excellent written and verbal communication.Nice-to-Have SkillsGCP Professional Data Engineer or Cloud Architect certificationExperience with Atlan or comparable governance platforms (Collibra, Alation, Unity Catalog)Experience with multi-region active-active or active-passive deployments on GCPProduction experience operating Confluent Cloud at significant scaleFamiliarity with spec-driven development workflows, particularly with AI-assisted code generationExperience replacing or sunsetting legacy healthcare data platforms (Optum Health Data Engine, Innovaccer, Health Catalyst, Arcadia) is unique and highly relevantIf you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

title: Manager - IT (Master Data Management)
description:
**About Shalina Healthcare:**

We are one of the largest, privately owned pharmaceutical businesses across Africa (Global Head Quarters- Dubai, UAE) with recent forays across multiple, new lines of businesses including Diagnostics and Consumer Healthcare.

Over the last 40 years, operating across multiple geographies, we have made it our mission to provide quality medicines to those who need it the most. We manufacture and distribute branded prescription and over-the-counter pharmaceutical and consumer products, across a broad range of therapeutic groups, including anti-malarial, antibiotics, anti-inflammatory, respiratory, gastrointestinal, nutrition, oral care, dermatology, sexual well-being, and antiseptic liquids & soaps. Leading brands, great teams and a focus on influencing the well-being of people have made Shalina a household name in Africa.

We have a track record few can match, and our brands are among the most trusted in Africa. We are proud of our history and have big ambitions for the future. Our vision for 2030 is to be the health champion of Sub-Saharan Africa. To achieve this, we are looking for the right people to join us and create a lasting impact not just within our company but on the communities that we serve; people who identify with our Core Values and are as passionate about our Mission as we are.

Visit https://www.linkedin.com/company/shalina-healthcare to learn more about us.

***What you become a part of
:***

This is a
**build role**
responsible for establishing and leading Shalina Healthcare’s group-wide Master Data Management (MDM) function. The role will define the operating model, governance framework, standards, processes, technology and quality measures for master data across our manufacturing operations in India and distribution markets across Africa.

The successful candidate will build a federated MDM capability from a relatively low baseline — establishing clear data ownership, governance standards, request-to-publish workflows, service levels and data quality measures, while building the central MDM team.

Master data is a critical foundation for the Group’s analytics, digital and AI agenda, and this role will play a key part in establishing that foundation.

***What to expect
:***

**Operating Model and Data Governance:**

* Establish and manage the Group MDM operating model, including decision rights across the central function, business data owners and country data stewards.
* Define and maintain master data policies, standards, taxonomies, hierarchies and governance frameworks across all domains.
* Establish and run regular Data Governance Forums and support the Data Governance Council with quality scorecards and change priorities.
* Partner with senior business stakeholders to establish clear ownership and accountability for master data.

**Data Standards and Stewardship:**

* Define and maintain data standards, attribute definitions, code sets and business rules.
* Establish clear guidelines for global versus local data requirements and manage exceptions effectively.
* Resolve cross-functional and cross-market data conflicts, escalating significant business trade-offs to the Council, where required.
* Drive consistent adoption of master data standards across countries and business functions.

**Operations and Service Delivery:**

* Own the end-to-end master data lifecycle, including creation, modification, blocking and deletion.
* Establish service levels for master data requests and monitor adherence through regular reporting.
* Drive automation of routine master data processes to improve efficiency and enable stewards to focus on governance and exceptions.
* Build and manage the MDM operations team and develop the shared-service capability.

**Data Quality and Reporting:**

* Establish data quality baselines and measurement frameworks across key master data domains.
* Define and monitor metrics covering completeness, accuracy, uniqueness, timeliness and conformance.
* Publish regular data quality dashboards and scorecards for business stakeholders.
* Identify recurring data quality issues and drive root-cause resolution through upstream process improvements.

**Technology and Change Delivery:**

* Define business and functional requirements for the selection, implementation and ongoing development of the Group’s MDM platform.
* Lead the integration of master data with ERP, SFA, planning and other enterprise systems.
* Develop and execute a phased MDM roadmap aligned to business priorities, timelines and budgets.
* Manage MDM technology initiatives and program budgets.

***Essential qualifications & experience
:***

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Management or a related discipline; Master's degree is preferred.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in data management, data governance or MDM, with at least 4 years leading a master data or data governance function.
* Experience in pharmaceutical, FMCG, consumer healthcare or regulated manufacturing environments is preferred.
* Demonstrated experience in building or significantly transforming an MDM/data governance capability, rather than only operating an established function.
* Hands-on experience with at least one enterprise MDM platform and integration with major ERP platforms such as SAP S/4HANA or Microsoft Dynamics/Business Central.
* Strong understanding of at least two core master data domains, such as Product/Material, Customer, Vendor or Finance.

***Desired skills & attributes
:***

* Strong understanding of business processes and master data dependencies within ERP environments.
* Experience with African markets or comparable emerging-market distribution environments is an advantage.
* Exposure to analytics, digital transformation or AI initiatives and their master data dependencies.
* Proven ability to establish data ownership and influence senior business stakeholders without direct authority.
* Experience building, leading and developing a new team.
* Strong stakeholder management and change management capabilities across functions and geographies.
* Ability to balance global standards with legitimate local business requirements.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data quality issues into business impact across service, margin, cash and compliance.
* Ability to drive adoption and accountability while managing exceptions in a practical and commercially sensible manner.
* Comfortable working across Indian manufacturing operations and multiple African markets.

***Why Join Us
?***

* Be part of a fast-growing, mission-led organization transforming healthcare access in Africa.
* Lead the development of a group-wide MDM capability from the ground up.
* Work with diverse teams across India, Dubai and multiple African markets.
* Play a key role in enabling the Group’s broader analytics, digital and AI transformation agenda.
* Opportunity to operate in a dynamic, international environment with room for growth and innovation.

***Application*
:**

If this role is of interest to you, please upload a recent copy of your CV and a member of the Talent Acquisition team will be in touch. We believe that equal opportunities mean inclusion, diversity and fair treatment for all.

title: Risk Architecture Associate
description:
**Job Description**
The candidate will be responsible for building data monitoring & controls primarily for Risk Decision Engines and Third-party services within Consumer & Community Banking. The candidate will be expected to have a detailed understanding of system requirements, data quality and lineage controls. The candidate is will also be responsible for data monitoring and reporting and supporting post implementation validations during releases for any changes made to decision engines to ensure accuracy of decisioning and support root cause analysis in case of production issues or defects.

* Automation & Governance: Lead reporting and monitoring automation initiatives, maintain documentation and lineage controls, and ensure compliance with risk governance, RCSA, and control requirements.

* Hands-on experience with BI and visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, QlikView, Alteryx, and the Big Data ecosystem.
* Strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
* Experience working in Agile frameworks, managing time-sensitive deliverables, and maintaining a high level of attention to detail.

title: Lead Risk Reporting Analyst, Python AI, VP (Hybrid)
description:
Citi is looking for a Lead Risk Reporting Analyst to shape the future of Market Risk intelligence — designing scalable, Python-powered reporting solutions that inform senior leadership, regulators, and auditors across one of the world's most influential financial institutions. Sitting within Citi's Management Reporting function, this senior individual contributor role operates with significant autonomy to modernize how risk data is structured, visualized, and consumed at scale. You will act as a recognized subject matter expert, partnering across Risk, Technology, and Business teams to replace legacy approaches with strategic, AI-driven solutions that deliver lasting impact.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design and deliver scalable Python-based reporting and dashboard solutions for Market Risk teams, replacing manual and legacy processes with efficient, data-driven outputs.
* Architect a dedicated reporting data layer in collaboration with Technology, enabling fast, reliable access to risk data across portfolio concentrations, limit exceptions, stress testing, loss reserves, and high-risk exposures.
* Assess and select the right tooling approach for each use case, distinguishing between reporting and dashboarding needs to ensure the correct solution is applied using Tableau, Python, or other BI platforms.
* Produce and contribute to risk reports for internal management, regulators, and auditors, covering Credit, Market, Operational, and other risk portfolios with accuracy and clarity.
* Partner with IT and Business stakeholders to standardize reporting views and build scalable frameworks that can be adopted across multiple Risk teams.
* Review and streamline existing reporting processes to eliminate inefficiencies, reducing complexity while maintaining accuracy and timeliness.
* Develop and deploy innovative, AI-based reporting solutions that modernize how risk data is analyzed and presented at the senior leadership level.
* Mentor team members in reporting standards, analytical methodologies, and BI tooling to build collective capability across the function.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Proficiency in Python, including advanced scripting and workflow development, applied to real-world data analysis and automated reporting.
* Hands-on capability in Tableau dashboard development, with the ability to translate complex risk data into clear, actionable visual outputs.
* Solid grounding in data architecture and data warehousing concepts, with the ability to design and optimize data layers that support large-scale reporting.
* Ability to query and optimize across multiple databases and BI tools, with working knowledge of SQL and query performance tuning.
* Track record of influencing senior business stakeholders and guiding teams toward the adoption of strategic, standardized reporting solutions.
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field; a Master's degree is preferred.

**Beneficial Skills & Qualifications**

* 10 or more years of business intelligence experience, with exposure to enterprise-scale reporting environments.
* Familiarity with Market Risk data, including experience working with risk metrics such as portfolio concentrations, stress testing outputs, or limit monitoring.
* Demonstrated experience building innovative and scalable AI-based solutions within a regulated or data-intensive environment.

What We Offer
  
  
This is a senior role that offers real influence over how risk intelligence is built and consumed at Citi. You will work at the intersection of data engineering, business intelligence, and risk analytics — with the autonomy to challenge conventional approaches and embed AI-driven thinking into one of the world's most consequential financial risk functions.
  
  

* A hybrid working model that balances 3 days in the office with 2 days working remotely, giving you structure and flexibility.
* Direct access to senior stakeholders across Risk, Technology, and Business, with the platform to influence firmwide reporting strategy.
* The opportunity to lead the adoption of AI and advanced analytics within an established risk reporting function, making a visible and lasting impact.
* A performance-driven environment where technical expertise and strategic thinking are recognized and rewarded.
* Access to Citi's global network, connecting you with colleagues and projects across international markets and business lines.
* Ongoing learning and development opportunities, including exposure to emerging technologies and evolving risk management practices.
* Competitive compensation and financial wellbeing support, commensurate with a senior individual contributor position.

Apply now to lead the transformation of risk reporting at Citi — and put your Python, AI, and data expertise to work where it will genuinely matter.

+ Veeam Certified Engineer

+ SAP Technology Consultant

* Moderate level knowledge in ticketing tools preferably Service Now.

* Moderate level experience working with vendors and/or 3rd parties.
